text: Oncology is a clinical discipline that studies the occurrence and development mechanisms, diagnosis, treatment and prevention of tumors (benign and malignant tumors). As a core branch of the medical field, it integrates knowledge from multiple disciplines such as cell biology, genetics, immunology, surgery, and radiotherapy, dedicated to revealing the essence of tumors and prolonging patients' survival and improving their quality of life through comprehensive treatments (surgery, chemotherapy, targeted therapy, immunotherapy, etc.). Modern oncology has shifted from a single treatment model to "precision medicine", emphasizing the formulation of individualized plans based on the molecular characteristics of tumors.
